result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits, including conditional USD 5 million cyber coverage and certificates on request. However, requiring every policy to remain in force for one year after the Term exceeds the playbook and is not explained by the margin comment. The redline also unnecessarily relocates existing subsection (iii) ahead of the Section 14 heading, impairing document organization. The added insurance language is otherwise clear and preserves the substance of the existing provisions.
